title: perf(web): load page code on first use, not at boot

summaries.body:
## Maple review 🟡 **Confidence 6/10** · needs attention Held at 6 because 22 reviewed files were not read. 2 warnings −2 · risk medium · 22 files not read Splits every page into a small `index.ts` entry plus a lazily imported `implementation.ts`, and adds `Model.pageCode` so a route enters only once its code has arrived, behind a skeleton or a reloadable failure. The split is faithful to main; one preload path loses its cancellation check. - Each page's `index.ts` holds only `definePage` plus `entry.lazy(() => import("./implementation"))` - `loadPageCode` caches page code; `loadPage` awaits it and shows a skeleton or `PageCode.Failed` - Page subscriptions run in 24 fixed registry slots instead of one per page - `LoadPageCode` stays a kept command span carrying `maple.page.id` ### Findings
🟠 Warning · F1 · LoadPageCode completion preloads a hover the user already cancelled correctness · [`apps/web/src/update.ts:487`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/2b63ff8d33e279beacef55486f22ed194a51cd90/apps/web/src/update.ts#L487) This branch runs `preloadLink` whenever the page code arrives, without checking that the link intent still exists. Hovering a nav link to an unloaded page starts `LoadPageCode`; if the pointer leaves before the chunk arrives (`EndedLinkIntent` → `Preload.ended`), the completion still runs that page's preload Commands, so every abandoned hover fires the page's reads and holds their answers. `Preload.elapsed` removes the intent before the load starts, so the intent has to stay registered until the code arrives for this branch to check it the way `ElapsedPreloadDelay` does (`update.ts:1130`). ``` Keep the intent (do not `Preload.ended` it when the page's code still has to load) and gate this step on `Preload.elapsed(model.preload, preloadHref, version)` returning `Some`, as the `ElapsedPreloadDelay` handler does. ```
🟠 Warning · F2 · A hover that ends before the page code arrives still runs that page's preloads correctness · [`apps/web/src/update.ts:487`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/2b63ff8d33e279beacef55486f22ed194a51cd90/apps/web/src/update.ts#L487) `loadedPageCode` fires `preloadLink` whenever the page code arrives, without the liveness check that `ElapsedPreloadDelay` makes through `Preload.elapsed`. `Preload.elapsed` has already cleared the intent before `LoadPageCode` was issued, so a hover that ends while the chunk is in flight (`EndedLinkIntent` → ended) is indistinguishable from a live one and the page's preload Commands run anyway, firing reads for a page the user left. ``` Keep the intent registered until the code arrives (don't clear it while the page's code is still unloaded) and gate the preload branch on `Preload.elapsed(model.preload, preloadHref, nowMs)` returning `Some`, as the `ElapsedPreloadDelay` handler does. ```

> <sub>F1 · Warning · correctness</sub>

This branch runs `preloadLink` whenever the page code arrives, without checking that the link intent still exists.
